title: Flat-band-induced integer doping and phase transition in monolayer graphene
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11254-4

An architecture comprising monolayer graphene doubly aligned to bulk and monolayer hBN on either side shows a gate-tunable global structural phase transition between two stacking configurations, accompanied by flat-band-induced integer doping.
